# Cosmo Job Assistant (llms.txt)

> Cosmo is a Naukri Easy Apply co-pilot and job application tracker by Cosmovai.

## Product

- Name: Cosmo / Cosmo Job Assistant
- Company: Cosmovai
- Website: https://www.cosmovai.in/
- Chrome extension: https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/cosmo-job-assistant/gdapodjlojmapjdopfdnmhfhhlfamgkb

## What Cosmo is

- Preference-based scanning of Naukri listings
- Human-paced assisted Easy Apply in the user's browser (explicit consent required)
- Sync of application activity into the Cosmo dashboard tracker
- Plans: Free, Pro, Max (INR, Razorpay) with assisted-apply safety caps

## What Cosmo is not

- Unattended bulk-apply or silent mass apply bots
- A multi-board Greenhouse / Workday / Ashby co-pilot today (current focus is Naukri)
- A guarantee of interviews or job offers
